data: real anonymized ULB/Worldline credit-card fraud benchmark
split_protocol: chronological by Time; simultaneous timestamps stay in one split
limitations: Only two days of historical 2013 data; not production validation.
No account identifiers: account velocity features cannot be evaluated.
V1-V28 are publisher-provided PCA features; their original preprocessing cannot be audited.
SHAP values for PCA components are mathematical contributions, not human-readable reasons.

confidence_intervals.method: stratified row bootstrap; temporal dependence not modeled

policy.method: expected costs; fixed before test evaluation, imperfect review assumed

score_shift_policy_to_test.note: PSI threshold 0.2 is heuristic; investigate before acting.

note: Frozen original benchmark models; additional diagnostics do not refit or select on test data.
